text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainie! Hurry, hurry~!
The food over here looks amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: A pyramid-style mille-crêpe with domestic carrot cream! It's so huge!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I thought this was French cuisine, but they've
given it a spicy twist! And over there—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: There you are. Vivlos and the others!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Crown! Dia!
Thanks for inviting me today!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The location is awesome, and the food is great too ♡
This is fusion cuisine, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is original fusion cuisine that combines
ingredients, seasonings, and techniques
from various countries.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Enjoy the feast prepared by Satono's
finest personal chefs... ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Which means, which means! If we eat everything,
we can travel around the world through food?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: It makes my heart flutter~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna eat everyyything♡
I wanna devour everything to the ends of the earth♡"
choice_data_list: Eating all of that is too much.
Let's eat it all and travel the world!

text_block_list.text:
Vivlos has a smaller appetite.
Overeating would put too much strain on her.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? But still, I really wanna feel
what it's like to go around the world~..."
choice_data_list: How about a world tour of cuisine to feast your eyes on?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see!
So you're sightseeing while taking photos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
! That's right!
Traveling isn't just about gourmet food after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa♡ As expected of Trainy♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go then♪ Oh, and on the way,
let's take a selfie with the sparkling night view♡"
And so, Vivlos resisted the temptation and held back from binge eating.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Trai-chi's getting into the groove~♪
Let's do this, let's do this~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No one can stop this fluttering heartbeat of mine~♡
And so, Vivlos savored the fusion cuisine, getting a full taste of a trip around the world.
